theorems.name: Submission.codim1_rdo_dg_volume_density_lower
theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (D F : Set (Euclid (m + 1))) (μ : Measure (Euclid (m + 1))) (ν : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1)) (y v : Euclid (m + 1)), 1 ≤ m → IsOpen D → MeasurableSet F → μ Dᶜ = 0 → (∀ K : Set (Euclid (m + 1)), IsCompact K → K ⊆ D → μ K ≠ ∞) → Measurable ν → (∀ z, ‖ν z‖ = 1) → (∀ φ : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1), ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ D → ∫ z in F, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid (m + 1)) (fderiv ℝ φ z : Euclid (m + 1) →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid (m + 1)) = -∫ z, inner ℝ (φ z) (ν z) ∂μ) → y ∈ D → ‖v‖ = 1 → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ => (μ (closedBall y ρ)).toReal⁻¹ • ∫ z in closedBall y ρ, ν z ∂μ) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 v) → ∃ c ρ₂ : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ 0 < ρ₂ ∧ ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < ρ₂ → ENNReal.ofReal (c * ρ ^ (m + 1)) ≤ volume (F ∩ ball y ρ) ∧ ENNReal.ofReal (c * ρ ^ (m + 1)) ≤ volume (ball y ρ \ F)
